_readme: Corrections applied on top of content/research/*.json by scripts/build-data.mjs. 'remove' drops duplicates; 'patch' merges fields into an item by id.

robot-club.tip: It's one of the rooms inside Instant-Fogas, so you get both in one night. Busiest Thursday to Saturday.

szimply.tip: Eggs Benedict or a big brunch plate. No Sunday service, so don't plan the Sunday recovery here.

zugliget-chairlift.tip: Check bkk.hu before heading out: it shuts for maintenance and bad weather, and a renovation is due to start.

great-market-hall.blurb: Neo-Gothic food cathedral. Paprika, sausages, pálinka downstairs; lángos and goulash upstairs. Do it Saturday morning: most of it is shut on Sunday.

mtk-vasas.notes: Confirmed by the booking: Friday 16 Oct, gates from 18:00, kick-off 19:00 Budapest time (18:00 UK). Opponent per MTK’s own fixture page.
mtk-vasas.tip: Gates open 18:00: grab a beer and a sausage and soak up the tiny-ground atmosphere. Allow 25 min from the Airbnb and aim to be in by 18:30.

for-sale-pub.blurb: The post-it note bar: every inch of wall and ceiling is covered in handwritten notes from visitors, with straw and peanut shells on the floor. Grab a pen, leave your mark, drink. Opposite the Great Market Hall.

karting-hungaroring.notes: Booked for 12:00. The venue is inside the Hungaroring grounds and runs on a temporary track during the circuit’s renovation. A taxi from the centre is roughly 12,000–14,000 HUF.

fradi-plzen.notes: Kick-off 21:00 Budapest time (20:00 UK) per UEFA’s fixture list; check uefa.com on the day. Gates-open time not published yet.

chain-bridge.hours: Open 24/7 on foot. Cars have been banned since the 2023 renovation, so it is a nice walk across.

tank-driving.tip: Book well ahead and ring the operator for the exact meeting point: listings disagree on where you start.

retro-langos.notes: The Bajcsy-Zsilinszky út branch shut on 31 Aug 2026 for a revamp, due back on 8 Oct: check Google Maps. If it is still shut, the Vécsey utca 3 branch by Parliament is open daily 11:00–22:00.

babel.blurb: One Michelin star since 2019, tucked near Elisabeth Bridge. Modern Hungarian with a bit of flair. Saturday lunch is the easiest table to get.

leo-rooftop.blurb: Eighth-floor jungle terrace at the Buda end of the Chain Bridge. Grand views, pricey cocktails: one for the photos at sunset.

costes.notes: Costes is in DiningCity Restaurant Week until 18 Oct 2026, the first Michelin-starred restaurant to take part: worth checking for a cheaper set-menu table.
